sources.title: What is the logic to create a conversation URL from the fields returned in the Intercom conversations API? | Community
Webhook Topics | Intercom and Fin Developer Platform

notes: The webhook payload includes a 'data.item' object with 'type': 'conversation', containing 'id' and 'url' fields as referenced in the plan.
To trigger on 'refund' tag, subscribe to the 'conversation_part.tag.created' topic and filter for tag.name == 'refund' in the connector logic.
The conversation URL format is: https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/<app_id>/inbox/conversations/<conversation_id> where <conversation_id> matches the 'id' field.
Intercom signs webhooks with X-Hub-Signature header (SHA1 HMAC of body using client_secret) for verification.
The 'description' field is read-only; use 'comment.body' to set the ticket description/first comment.
Subject is required in Agent Workspace but optional via API; if omitted, the first comment becomes the subject on first update in workspace.
Authentication uses Bearer token format: 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'.
No pagination is involved in ticket creation; this is a single POST operation.
